name: Wilhelmina Work
source:
Willi always knew what she wanted to be, and she got an early start. While her peers were still figuring things out, Willi was already firmly up the ladder and has been climbing ever since. But the thing about getting to the top of the ladder is that it really gives you a view of everything you're missing. She has no interests to speak of, to say nothing of a love life. In fact, while others find social interactions as easy as breathing, that's the one thing she really hasn't been able to master. Ever the overachiever, Wilhemina has set out to conquer this mountain. She certainly has the time now, with AI on the rise...
Likes: Aptitude, Strong Handshakes
Dislikes: Ineptitude, Yogurt

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
